info.name: Archi Online Capability Model
info.documentation: A self-describing ArchiMate model of the Archi Online browser app. It is intentionally detailed enough to exercise inline encoding, gist-backed sharing, read-only viewing, properties inspection, and open-copy editing.

properties.value: Milestone 1 model sharing and viewer capability

id-el-modeling-service.name: ArchiMate modeling service
id-el-modeling-service.documentation: The user-facing capability for authoring and maintaining ArchiMate models.

id-el-review-service.name: Model review service
id-el-review-service.documentation: The user-facing capability for opening a shared model as a read-only review surface.

id-el-author-process.name: Author model
id-el-author-process.documentation: Create, edit, script, layout, and save an architecture model.

id-el-share-process.name: Share model
id-el-share-process.documentation: Generate a share URL and, when needed, publish the serialized model to GitHub Gist.

id-el-review-process.name: Inspect shared model
id-el-review-process.documentation: Open a viewer link, select views, pan and zoom, and inspect properties without editing the shared model.

id-el-copy-process.name: Open copy for editing
id-el-copy-process.documentation: Clone a read-only shared model into a normal editor session.

id-el-architecture-model.name: Architecture model
id-el-architecture-model.documentation: The conceptual model being edited and reviewed.

id-el-review-link.name: Review link
id-el-review-link.documentation: A URL containing an inline fragment, gist id, or raw GitHub model URL.

id-el-spa.name: Archi Online SPA
id-el-spa.documentation: The React/Vite browser application containing the editor, viewer, persistence, scripting, and extension surfaces.

id-el-runtime-boot.name: App runtime boot
id-el-runtime-boot.documentation: Chooses editor or viewer mode from URL state and hydrates only the stores required for that mode.

id-el-app-shell.name: Docked editor shell
id-el-app-shell.documentation: Normal editable application shell with toolbar, dock layout, model tree, canvas views, properties, scripting, settings, and extensions.

id-el-viewer-shell.name: Read-only viewer shell
id-el-viewer-shell.documentation: Lightweight shell for shared models with source label, view picker, canvas, properties, and open-copy action.

id-el-toolbar.name: Toolbar and share command
id-el-toolbar.documentation: Creates new models, opens/saves files, and runs the share flow with inline or gist-backed links.

id-el-view-editor.name: SVG view editor
id-el-view-editor.documentation: Renders ArchiMate views on SVG, including editable interactions in editor mode and pan/zoom inspection in read-only mode.

id-el-properties-panel.name: Properties panel
id-el-properties-panel.documentation: Shows concept metadata and edits properties in normal mode while hiding mutating controls in read-only mode.

id-el-model-tree.name: Model tree
id-el-model-tree.documentation: Navigates model folders, elements, relationships, and views.

id-el-model-store.name: Normalized model store
id-el-model-store.documentation: Zustand store for ModelState, selection, active view, tools, dirty state, undo/redo, and read-only mode.

id-el-undo-redo.name: Transaction and undo/redo operations
id-el-undo-redo.documentation: Routes model mutations through transactions so UI, scripting, and undo/redo stay consistent.

id-el-xml-io.name: ArchiMate XML I/O
id-el-xml-io.documentation: Parser and serializer for Archi native .archimate XML.

id-el-share-encoding.name: Share encoding module
id-el-share-encoding.documentation: Compresses inline share payloads, parses fragments, loads shared models, and remembers gist associations.

id-el-github-persistence.name: GitHub Gist persistence module
id-el-github-persistence.documentation: Creates, updates, and reads GitHub Gists and raw GitHub model URLs.

id-el-file-persistence.name: File persistence module
id-el-file-persistence.documentation: Uses File System Access and download fallback for opening and saving .archimate files.

id-el-autosave.name: IndexedDB autosave
id-el-autosave.documentation: Stores and restores editor workspaces, but is deliberately skipped while booting shared viewer links.

id-el-settings-store.name: Settings store
id-el-settings-store.documentation: Persists canvas, layout, and behavior preferences.

id-el-extension-runtime.name: Extension runtime
id-el-extension-runtime.documentation: Loads extension packages, exposes commands, panels, context menus, and app events.

id-el-script-runner.name: jArchi script runner
id-el-script-runner.documentation: Executes scripts against the model API and reports console output.

id-el-monaco-editor.name: Monaco script editor
id-el-monaco-editor.documentation: Provides the browser code editor used by scripting and extension source editing.

id-el-elk-extension.name: ELK layout extension
id-el-elk-extension.documentation: Example extension applying ELK layout to model views.

id-el-model-editing-app-service.name: Browser model editing
id-el-model-editing-app-service.documentation: Application service exposed by the editor shell.

id-el-viewer-app-service.name: Read-only model viewing
id-el-viewer-app-service.documentation: Application service exposed by the viewer shell.

id-el-share-app-service.name: Share link generation
id-el-share-app-service.documentation: Application service that produces inline, gist-backed, or raw-source viewer links.

id-el-gist-app-service.name: Gist publication
id-el-gist-app-service.documentation: Application service that stores large shared models in GitHub Gist.

id-el-xml-app-service.name: XML import/export
id-el-xml-app-service.documentation: Application service for Archi native file interchange.

id-el-extension-app-service.name: Extension API
id-el-extension-app-service.documentation: Application service consumed by local extensions and future automation.

id-el-scripting-app-service.name: jArchi-compatible scripting
id-el-scripting-app-service.documentation: Application service for executing scripts against the current model.

id-el-model-state.name: ModelState graph
id-el-model-state.documentation: Normalized in-memory model: folders, concepts, views, nodes, connections, and model metadata.

id-el-archimate-xml.name: .archimate XML document
id-el-archimate-xml.documentation: Serialized Archi native XML used by disk persistence, gist sharing, and raw URL loading.

id-el-inline-payload.name: Compressed inline share payload
id-el-inline-payload.documentation: Deflated XML encoded as base64url in the URL fragment.

id-el-gist-link-data.name: Gist-backed viewer link
id-el-gist-link-data.documentation: Viewer URL containing #gist=<id> for a model stored in GitHub Gist.

id-el-raw-url-data.name: Raw GitHub model URL
id-el-raw-url-data.documentation: Viewer URL containing #raw=<url> that points at GitHub raw content.

id-el-workspace-data.name: IndexedDB workspace
id-el-workspace-data.documentation: Autosave, settings, token, and gist association records stored in browser IndexedDB.

id-el-local-file-data.name: Local .archimate file
id-el-local-file-data.documentation: A file selected through File System Access or downloaded from the app.

id-el-extension-package-data.name: Extension package
id-el-extension-package-data.documentation: Extension source or package manifest and files.

id-el-browser-runtime.name: Browser runtime
id-el-browser-runtime.documentation: Modern browser executing the SPA and providing DOM, Clipboard, File System Access, and IndexedDB APIs.

id-el-static-host.name: Static web host
id-el-static-host.documentation: Hosts the built Vite assets for Archi Online.

id-el-github-platform.name: GitHub platform
id-el-github-platform.documentation: External platform providing Gist and raw content endpoints.

id-el-local-device.name: User workstation
id-el-local-device.documentation: The device running the browser and holding local files.

id-el-react-runtime.name: React
id-el-react-runtime.documentation: UI runtime used by the app shells, panels, and dialogs.

id-el-vite-build.name: Vite build
id-el-vite-build.documentation: Development server and production bundler for the browser app.

id-el-typescript.name: TypeScript
id-el-typescript.documentation: Strict TypeScript source layer for application and model behavior.

id-el-elk-lib.name: ELK.js
id-el-elk-lib.documentation: Graph layout engine used by extension functionality.

id-el-fflate-lib.name: fflate
id-el-fflate-lib.documentation: Compression library used for inline share payloads.

id-el-gist-api.name: GitHub Gist API
id-el-gist-api.documentation: api.github.com/gists create, update, and metadata read endpoints.

id-el-raw-content.name: GitHub raw content
id-el-raw-content.documentation: gist.githubusercontent.com and raw.githubusercontent.com model file reads.

id-el-filesystem-api.name: File System Access API
id-el-filesystem-api.documentation: Browser API for opening and saving local model files when available.

id-el-indexeddb-api.name: IndexedDB API
id-el-indexeddb-api.documentation: Browser database used by autosave, settings, token, and gist association stores.

id-el-clipboard-api.name: Clipboard API
id-el-clipboard-api.documentation: Browser API used to place share links on the clipboard.

id-el-static-assets.name: Production static assets
id-el-static-assets.documentation: Built HTML, CSS, JavaScript, workers, Monaco assets, and ELK bundle.

id-el-gist-file-artifact.name: Gist .archimate file
id-el-gist-file-artifact.documentation: The .archimate file stored inside a GitHub Gist.

id-el-enterprise-architect.name: Enterprise Architect
id-el-enterprise-architect.documentation: Owns model quality and uses Archi Online to inspect, edit, and share ArchiMate models.

id-el-model-author.name: Model Author
id-el-model-author.documentation: Creates and edits models in the browser, then shares links for review.

id-el-reviewer.name: Model Reviewer
id-el-reviewer.documentation: Opens shared models without installing Archi or receiving editable files.

id-el-extension-developer.name: Extension Developer
id-el-extension-developer.documentation: Adds local extensions and scripts through the app extension surface.

id-el-browser-first-driver.name: Browser-first enterprise modeling
id-el-browser-first-driver.documentation: Architecture work should be possible from a modern browser without a desktop Archi install.

id-el-review-driver.name: Fast model review loops
id-el-review-driver.documentation: Sharing a model should be as easy as sending a link while preserving model fidelity.

id-el-url-risk.name: Long inline links are fragile
id-el-url-risk.documentation: Real models exceed practical URL limits in browsers, chat clients, and email tools.

id-el-edit-goal.name: Edit ArchiMate models in the browser
id-el-edit-goal.documentation: Provide a usable browser modeler with canvas editing, properties, persistence, and scripting.

id-el-share-goal.name: Share models for review
id-el-share-goal.documentation: Create a link that opens the same model in read-only mode.

id-el-readonly-goal.name: Keep review links read-only
id-el-readonly-goal.documentation: Reviewers can inspect the model and open an editable copy, but the shared source is never mutated by viewing.

id-el-fidelity-goal.name: Preserve Archi .archimate fidelity
id-el-fidelity-goal.documentation: Import, edit, serialize, and round-trip Archi native XML without losing structure relevant to this app.

id-el-share-links-req.name: URL and gist share links
id-el-share-links-req.documentation: Small models use compressed fragments; larger models publish a .archimate file to GitHub Gist.

id-el-zero-auth-req.name: Zero-auth viewer loading
id-el-zero-auth-req.documentation: Public and secret gist links, plus GitHub raw URLs, open in the viewer without requiring a GitHub token.

id-el-copy-req.name: Open shared model as editable copy
id-el-copy-req.documentation: The viewer can switch into the full editor with a cloned model and autosave restore disabled for that transition.

id-el-token-req.name: GitHub token stays local
id-el-token-req.documentation: The gist token is stored in local IndexedDB key-value storage and is only sent to api.github.com.

id-el-gist-reuse-req.name: Reuse gist per model id
id-el-gist-reuse-req.documentation: Re-sharing a model updates the remembered gist id for the same model.info.id.

id-el-native-file-principle.name: Native .archimate remains source of truth
id-el-native-file-principle.documentation: Sharing and persistence are wrappers around the same ArchiMate XML model, not a separate export format.

id-el-m1-sharing.name: Milestone 1 model sharing
id-el-m1-sharing.documentation: Implemented read-only viewer links, inline payloads, GitHub gist-backed links, public raw loading, and open-copy editing.

id-el-m1-deliverable.name: Read-only viewer and gist sharing
id-el-m1-deliverable.documentation: The shipped capability under test with this model.
